mechanism: Itraconazole inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes ivermectin, leading to increased ivermectin plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor for ivermectin toxicity signs (neurotoxicity, hypotension); consider dose reduction of ivermectin or use alternative antifungal if possible; if coadministration necessary, use lowest effective doses and ensure adequate clinical monitoring.
